utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have they said what kind of repairs the drive is covering?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Not yet, but I’m going to ask when I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — if you find out, let me know. I’m mainly wondering whether it covers just basics or bigger fixes too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — if you need a hand with the repair drive, I can lend you some tools or help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I might take you up on that. I’m a bit scattered today, so I may need a quick reminder on what to grab.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem — just bring a screwdriver, a wrench, and a tape measure, and we’ll be set.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’ve been meaning to ask—have you heard if the repair drive’s still on this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not sure yet, but I’d want to confirm the timing before counting on it. If it’s still on, I’ll need to figure out how to get there and what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I can check around and see what I hear. If it’s on, I’ll let you know the time and any list of things to bring.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you head to the community shed and check the shelf by the back wall for the spare extension cords?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’ll head to the community shed and check the shelf by the back wall for the spare extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, perfect — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away. If you’ve got any details to share, send them over and I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll send the details soon—just keeping it simple for now.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good — I’ll keep it simple too and let folks know the details are coming soon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone posted. Leo, tell me what needs the most attention first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Start with the leaking faucet and the loose porch step.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Got it — I’ll put the leaking faucet and loose porch step at the top of the list and get them addressed first.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll double-check the details before we do anything. What do we know so far about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Not much yet—I’m a bit late to it. If you’ve got the basics, I can help fill in the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I only know it’s a repair drive, but I’m missing the key details too. Let’s start with the date, location, and what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school drop-off and pickup if that makes the repair drive easier. Just let me know the timing and I’ll work it into our schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be a huge help, Faye—thank you. I’ll send over the timing once I’ve got the repair drive slots lined up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks Mara—just send the slots when you have them. I’ll make sure we can fit it around school.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s getting set up soon—what do you know about it?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ve heard it’s coming together soon—mostly folks bringing tools, spare parts, and a list of things that need fixing. If you want, I can help spread the word or keep an eye out for what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great—if you hear what they still need, let me know and I’ll pass it along too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in—just send me the time and what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — can you confirm you’re free Saturday at 10? Just bring a screwdriver set if you have one.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, Saturday at 10 works for me. I’ll bring a screwdriver set if I can find it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Rey — I’m trying to remember the list. I know we still need to sort the donated tools and check which houses need the most help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can sort the donated tools if you want, and then I’ll check in on the houses that need help most.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and let folks know what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep track of the supplies and make sure we know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll tell people what to bring and where to help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting some good traction—people seem to be pitching in. I’ll keep an ear out for any updates while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate you keeping an ear out. I’ll let you know if I hear anything useful too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, Rey — I’ll check in while I’m out and let you know if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m happy to help out; what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren — could you bring a screwdriver set and some sturdy tape? I’ll handle the rest and keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll bring a screwdriver set and some sturdy tape. Just point me to where to drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What do we need to bring?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly tools, spare screws, and any small parts you’ve got lying around. If you can, bring gloves too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll bring whatever tools and spare screws I can find, plus gloves if I have them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli — if the repair drive needs any tools, I’ve got a few you can borrow.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s kind of you, Gus. I’ll make a quick list so I know what to ask for.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — just send it over when you’re ready, and I’ll see what I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to handle?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Could you help me spread the word and jot down any supplies people can bring? If you’re free, I’ll add you to the list and send the details over.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I can spread the word and keep a list of suggested supplies. Send me the details and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad the repair drive is coming together — I can help connect folks who need fixes with people who can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’d be great, Jules — I can keep a tidy list of who needs what and where to send the helpers.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll start introducing people who can help, and you can keep the list organized. Together we’ll make it easy for everyone to jump in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep an eye on supplies for the repair drive. Just tell me what you need, and I’ll check what we have.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be wonderful, Cleo. I’ll make a short supply list and bring it by so you can keep track of what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m a bit behind on the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We’re still collecting donations and a few folks are signing up to help this weekend. Do you want the latest list of needed items?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please—I'd love the latest list of needed items.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in — what needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — first up is the broken fence gate by the school lot, then the loose step by the entrance.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll take the fence gate first, then the loose step.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you just confirm what’s already covered and what you still need me to decide?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: So far, I’ve got my time and a toolbox covered; I still need you to decide whether we’re doing the yard cleanup or the shelf repair first.
